#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

bool check(int good, int bad, double proba) {
    double g = good;
    double b = bad;
    double ans = (0.25 * b * max(0.0, b - 1.0) * g +
                  (g * (max(0.0, g - 1.0) * max(0.0, g - 2.0) / 6.0) +
                   b * 0.5 * g * max(0.0, g - 1.0))) /
                 ((g + b) * max(0.0, g + b - 1.0) * max(0.0, g + b - 2.0) / 6.0);
    return ans >= proba;
}

int main() {
    int x;
    double prob;
    cin >> x >> prob;
    int pos = x;
    for (int a = x; a > 0; a /= 2) {
        while (pos >= a && check(pos - a, x - (pos - a), prob)) {
            pos -= a;
        }
    }
    cout << pos << endl;
    return 0;
}
